application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Erection of a single storey rear infill extension within existing excavated rear courtyard, with walk-over rooftop podium, retained access stairs and small retained basement level external courtyard space.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (D 01; D 02; D 03; D 04; 010; 030 Rev 00; 100 Rev 01  Received:  05 February 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors, skylights or other glazed openings shall be formed in the single storey rear infill extension within the house's existing excavated rear garden, including the proposed walk-over roof podium, hereby approved.
